svg.aria-label: Alert dimensional drawing: inline flow, content grid, dismiss hit area and logical layers
svg.text: FIXED GEOMETRY 2:1 · WIDTH PROPORTIONAL / CALLER DEFINED
CONTENT GRID: minmax(0,1fr) auto · TITLE COL 1 · CLOSE COL 2 / ROW 1
DESCRIPTION SPANS BOTH COLUMNS · NO INTERNAL ROW GAP
DESCRIPTION + DISMISS: ROW 1 RESERVED FOR CLOSE.
GLYPH MOVES DOWN BY S5 TO THE DESCRIPTION ROW.
DESCRIPTION ONLY: HEIGHT = n · H1; NO EXTRA HEADER.
ICON = null / false: REMOVE I1 + S2; CONTENT FILLS W.
IS A BOX REFERENCE, NOT A VISIBLE BORDER.
WITHOUT TITLE, DISMISS GETS THE FIRST ROW.
GLYPH TOP OFFSET TRACKS ONE LINE HEIGHT.
THE DISMISS HIT AREA EXTENDS OUTWARD.
NO SURFACE, SHADOW, CORNER OR SCRIM.
CLOSED CONTENT IS INERT DURING THE EXIT.
SOURCE GEOMETRY · ALL TONES SHARE THE SAME BOX
S1 SITS ABOVE THE ROOT; NO CONTAINER PADDING.
PROPORTIONAL · LOGICAL PARTS / Z SEPARATION SCHEMATIC
ROOT AND COLLAPSIBLE PANEL SHARE ONE DOM NODE.
POSITIONAL LAYER GAPS ARE DRAWING CONVENTIONS.
SCALE 1.5:1 · TONE CHANGES COLOUR ONLY · GEOMETRY IS IDENTICAL
